plugins.name: google-multi-account
plugins.description: Access Gmail, Google Calendar, and Google Drive across multiple Google accounts from Claude. Search, send, draft, and manage emails with attachments; manage calendar events; upload, download, search, and share Drive files — all with a configurable account parameter. Untrusted email content is sanitized before it reaches the model.

skills.name: google-setup
skills.description: This skill provides guidance for setting up the Google Multi-Account MCP plugin. Use when the user says "set up google accounts", "connect my gmail", "add a google account", "configure email", "google MCP setup", "connect my calendar", or asks about authenticating Google accounts with the plugin. Also trigger when the user encounters OAuth errors, token issues, or GCP configuration problems.
